title: Words to read and colour: Qalqalah in surahs we know
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 49 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 49. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Qalqalah in surahs we know). Then trace and copy.

arabic.text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ (١) ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ (٢) لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ (٣) وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ (٤)

panels.title: Stop and bounce
points: At the end of an ayah, the last letter goes quiet
If it is ق ط ب ج د it bounces
A small bounce, not a new vowel

questions.a: walam yulad, with a small bounce on the last د

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read Al-Ikhlas and Al-Falaq lines; colour every bounce yellow. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Bounces found: يَلِدْ، يُولَدْ، أَحَدٌ at a stop, ٱلْفَلَقِ at a stop.

questions.q: Extend: say Al-Ikhlas to a grown-up with every bounce.
When we stop on «أَحَدٌ», the د ...
questions.a: A) bounces a little. Stopping makes it sakin, and د is a qalqalah letter.

questions.q: Think again: When we stop at the end of an ayah, the last letter becomes quiet. What happens if it is a qalqalah letter?
questions.a: It bounces when we stop, like «ٱلْفَلَقِ» → al-falaq(q).
